product_from_film: Perplexity Personal Computer connects a Mac mini to an assistant that works across desktop apps and reports progress on a phone.
explains_well: The board-deck example shows a source report, a task request, an audience question and a finished file.
unclear: The finished deck and candidate results are too brief to judge what useful work was completed.
scenario: Recruit engineers, draft an investor email and turn a revenue report into a board deck
product_clear_basis: Connected Mac mini leads to an assistant dashboard and morning summary of completed work.

lessons.keep: Keep the audience clarification beside the source report before producing the deck.

Show one returned SwiftUI candidate with the exact requested experience fields, then close on the phone notification.
